_doc: Verdance, on Willow Tree (Rival & CADMIUM ft. Rosendale). The journey (2026-11-26) climbs the great tree: the roots (bars 0-7, a ring round Verdance among its roots; the Kindling gives the snap at 4; Helion's moment at 6); the drop (8) throws you up a vine into the trunk spiral (9-12, winding outward round the trunk at 1.25x); at 13 a vine flings you onto the branches (13-21, two boughs crossing, a figure-eight), the residue rising after you along it, pushed back by every good tap; the lift (19-21) at 1.5x, the camera pushing in, the dark closing to one light; the last drop (22) throws you into the canopy (23-26, a wide ring of leaves, every seed-light alight); at 27 the tree throws you to the crown, the camera pulls back over the whole relit tree, and on the crown you are two sparks at once (dual, 28-32), a sprint at 2x (30); the seal on the last stab (32).
Every bar is charted by hand (tools/journey.py from tools/journeys.py, then hand-tuned if need be). The id is the world's slot, not the song.
title: Willow Tree (feat. Rosendale)
adds: The snap: each tap jumps you to the other side of the branch at once; dual at the crown

setpieces.name: The snap
setpieces.what: Verdance's Kindling rises from the roots and gives the snap: each tap jumps you across the branch at once

setpieces.name: Helion's moment
setpieces.what: his motif, nearer now; his silhouette the clearest yet

setpieces.name: Up the vine
setpieces.what: the drop: the great node, a beat of stillness, the impact; a vine whips you up into the trunk spiral; Morrow climbs beside you

setpieces.name: Chased along the branches
setpieces.what: a vine flings you onto the long bough; the residue rises after you along it, pushed back by every good tap

setpieces.name: The lift
setpieces.what: 1.5x, the camera pushing in; the dark closes in until only his brother's signal is lit

setpieces.name: The canopy
setpieces.what: the last drop throws you into the canopy; every seed-light alight; Morrow lifts you on its hands

setpieces.name: The crown
setpieces.what: the tree throws you to its crown; the camera pulls back over the whole relit tree

setpieces.name: Two sparks
setpieces.what: on the crown you are two sparks at once (dual): Helion's signal answers as the second; a sprint at 2x

setpieces.name: The seal
setpieces.what: the last tap breaks the Stillness's seal on the star
